authority: E10 S5 Q1 (2026-09-29): the keyframe prompt's 机位说明 line was the inherited camera label, which extend_global_space_map.annotate_existing_cameras rewrites to the shot_size／camera of EVERY shot bound to that angle. Shots therefore carried other shots' actions, prop states and people (E10-S03-03 盯着木盒 put the box on the table early; E10-S10-01 捂着嘴 made 梁婉清 cover her mouth before speaking; E10-S05-01 掀开的木盒/秦铭的脸 rendered the end state). All three needed paid rerolls with hard overrides in the shot text.
active_note: Episodes below this number keep their byte-identical keyframe prompts (E01–E10 are paid, admitted or in S6 video production). Raise nothing retroactively.
note_template: 机位说明：机位 {angle_id}｜位置 {camera_position}｜朝向 {camera_facing}｜轴线 {axis_id}｜银幕方向 {screen_direction}｜景别 {shot_size}；本镜：{own_camera}
own_camera_source: prompt_spec.camera with the trailing machine suffix「；机位 …」removed (this shot's own authored camera text only); falls back to shot_size when empty
forbidden_source: subspace_layout.authored_camera_note (the multi-shot angle label) is never quoted into the prompt once active
